notes.title: Update 1.1. List of Changes:
notes.content:
Update 1.1. List of Changes:

Gameplay Fixes:
- Reduced camera recoil after taking damage.
- Modified character's reaction to grenade launcher damage.
- Adjusted excessively high difficulty level.
- After the battle ends, the music changes smoothly.
- Added the option to skip movie interludes.
- Fixed the cover point on the first level.
- Resolved object collision issues on level 2.

User Interface and Visual Options:
- Added background to the subtitles to enhance readability.
- Improved subtitles scaling.
- Introduced changes to the options menu.
- Added Gamma adjustment option.
- Added an option to disable subtitles.
- Optimized the appearance of the crosshair.

Visual and Audio Fixes:
- Increased the volume of certain dialogues.
- Fixed an inconsistency where the ammunition count displayed in the magazine did not match the count shown in the screen corner.
- Fixed an issue causing character rotation during cinematic cutscenes.
- Fixed dialogues that ended prematurely.

Achievements:
- Introduced new achievements.
- Translated achievements.

Performance Enhancements:
- Introduced several performance optimization tweaks.
